Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This message is used to disseminate the “seconds” part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Symbol Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all security symbols traded on MIAX PEARL Equities for the current trading session. The Symbol ID sent in this message will be disseminated in Top of Market and Last Sale messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Ticker Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol for the security in NASDAQ Integrated Platform format.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Test Security Indicator
Field.Description: 'Y' – Yes, 'N' – No

Field.Name: Spare
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Round Lot size in shares.

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:00:00

Field.Name: Primary Market Code
Field.Description: Primary Market Code Enum

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to notify firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to all symbols on the feed. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: DoM Version
Field.Description: Eg: DoM1.0

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Current trading session identifier.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: System Status

Message.Name: Security Trading Status Notification Message
Message.Description: This message is used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of a particular security.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status enums

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Market State enum

Field.Name: Short Sale Restriction
Field.Description: Current state of short sale restriction.

Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to indicate that the MIAX PEARL Equities book for a symbol has been cleared of all orders.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used when a displayed order is received and added to MIAX PEARL Equities book. It includes an Order ID that is unique to the order across the exchange and across trading days.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Matching engine assigned Order ID.

Field.Name: Order Side
Field.Description: Side of order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: MPID of the firm if attributed as such. “RTAL” if attributed as such. Space-filled if no attribution specified on the order by firm.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish price/size changes for an existing displayed order on MIAX PEARL Equities book.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Matching engine assigned Order ID.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to indicate that a displayed order has been removed from the MIAX PEARL Equities book.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Matching engine assigned Order ID.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: This message format is used when a displayed order on the book executes in whole or in part. The execution is identified by a unique Trade ID that is unique across the exchange for the trading day. Subsequent partial executions of the order would be published with the same Order ID but different Trade ID.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Matching engine assigned Order ID.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish trade executions for orders not displayed on the book. Executions for orders routed and executed in another trading center and trade corrections are also published using this message.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the time that applies to this message.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Set to zero for new trades. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish cancellation of a trade which was previously published via an Order Execution Message or a Trade Message.

Field.Description: Trade correction number. Set to zero for new trades. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.
